basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old music enthusiast living in Portland, Oregon. I spend a lot of my free time exploring new and underground music, especially hip-hop and rap. Apart from that, I enjoy hiking and photography. I'm currently working part-time in a local record store while figuring out my next steps career-wise, possibly in music production or event management. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to explore my interests at my own pace. I typically browse Reddit during late evenings, especially after my shifts at work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've always been passionate about music, with a particular interest in hip-hop and rap. This passion stems from a combination of attending local music events and self-teaching through online resources and communities. My role at the record store also keeps me updated with the latest releases and trends.
